(new, U343p) scripts/orchestrator/acp-broker:1669-1671: the trap is armed before the mkdir but keys its removal on slot_made, set by the command after it (slot_remove :387), and bash runs a trap only when the foreground child returns, before the next command: a TERM delivered while `/bin/mkdir "${slot}"` runs leaves the new empty slot under <seats-root>/.state (probe, artifact agents/parent-hunter/artifacts/trap-probe.txt). This is verdict U343o-c5c2b968 P1 :1648's class (handler-window) narrowed from two mkfifo and two exec to one exec; the signaller is the relay's stop (scripts/orchestrator/acp-relay.py:263-277), the broker's own process, and the remainder is an empty directory of the broker's user in no seat's write root, so no boundary is crossed (noted only). Smallest fix: set slot_made=1 before the mkdir and clear it in the mkdir's failure branch before refuse; the name `acp-<name>-<stamp>-<pid>` (:1226) is this process's own and .state is no seat's write root, so an entry the trap could then remove that this process did not make is a stale slot of a reused pid in the same second.
